differential.name: Acute non‑ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
differential.rationale: Recent MI diagnosis in a 51‑year‑old with hypertension, metabolic syndrome, and prior coronary disease makes ACS the most pressing likelihood.

differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (chronic kidney disease stage 1 secondary to diabetes)
differential.rationale: Presence of CKD, borderline‑elevated creatinine, high GFR (hyperfiltration), hypertension, and metabolic syndrome point to early diabetic nephropathy.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD, chronic inflammation, and recurrent infections is typical for anemia of chronic disease.

differential.name: Recurrent urinary tract infection
differential.rationale: History of repeated UTIs plus current urinary ketones/glucose suggest ongoing infection contributing to systemic symptoms.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome with insulin resistance (prediabetes)
differential.rationale: Obesity, hypertension, dyslipidemia, low‑normal glucose and very low A1c indicate underlying insulin resistance driving the patient’s comorbidities.
